note: Every player of Madden NFL 22's launch roster (the 2021 season) as [name, EA team id, Madden position, overall], read by npm run sync:madden-seasons from the sources scripts/data/nfl-seasons.json pins; npm run build:nfl-seasons builds the season from it.
